proposals.title: Proposal to Publish an Annual Report Disclosing Lobbying Activities
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust (SEIU)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Lilly's lobbying policies, lobbying and grassroots payments, trade association and model-legislation group payments, and oversight decision-making.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Report on Effectiveness of the Company's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Efforts
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Marguerite Casey Foundation
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the effectiveness of DEI efforts using quantitative metrics for workforce diversity, hiring, promotion and retention by gender, race and ethnicity.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Establish and Report on a Process by which the Impact of Extended Patent Exclusivities on Product Access Would be Considered in Deciding Whether to Apply for Secondary and Tertiary Patents
proposals.proponent: Trinity Health, as lead filer, with multiple additional cofilers
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a process considering the impact of extended patent exclusivities on product access when deciding whether to apply for secondary and tertiary patents, with a published report.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Adopt a Comprehensive Human Rights Policy
proposals.proponent: CommonSpirit Health, as lead filer, along with several co-filers
proposals.topic_summary: Urges adoption of a comprehensive human rights policy covering own operations and suppliers, including the right to health and a human rights due diligence process.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
